name: agentic-dev
description: Two skills that take any change from a request to a merge, against checks the agent writing the code never sees: a task skill for a change one check proves done, which asks at most one clarifying question and for the check, hides the check, and has a subagent make it pass from the simplest solution up in its own worktree; and a story skill for a feature or a whole product, which interviews you until nothing is ambiguous, confirms the acceptance criteria in plain language, splits them into vertical-slice stories with a walking skeleton first and files them, then builds one story at a time: a reviewed plan, design choices settled with you, hidden failing tests, slices of at most 200 lines each built as a task and reviewed, a final review and verification, a merge request watched to merge, and the UAT. Plus a pair-program skill where you write the code and the agent coaches you one mistake at a time with hints and the best practice behind each, writing only the failing tests and the chores; a spike skill that answers one question with throwaway code (an experiment, a prototype, an ML eval, a hardware or load test) and records the finding, reviewer and verifier agents, and hooks for a done check that runs every test and the linter, an AGENTS.md size cap, a dependency gate, gates on commits that leave in debugging leftovers, switch a checker off, or change, remove or skip a test the branch started with, a gate that hides a check from the agent writing the code, a slice cap, a gate on the first edit no skill framed, a gate on a pull request or merge no reviewer preceded, and no done check while you pair.
